narr: Monsoonal moisture allowed for another round of thunderstorms to develop over the San Bernardino Mountains on August 1st. Slow-moving storms allowed for efficient rainfall production, which led to flash flooding in the town of Big Bear and also over portions of Highway 38.
ev: Car stalled in 4 feet of water at Highway 38 at Stanfield Cutoff. Parties trapped inside were rescued by Fire Department. Road was closed to clear debris.

Roadway flooding near 1509 Shay Rd in Big Bear City. North and south side of Shay Road was flooded. Storm survey by WCM showed several inches of water still flowing over Shay Road. Radar estimated 2 to 3 inches of rain in less than 3 hours. Water flowed around numerous homes, flowing into Baldwin Lake. Nearby Big Bear Yard reported 1.80 inches.
Two to three feet of water flooding across the roadway at SR18 and Johnson Road.
